title: Derivative invariant under setting its coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on that cube. For every point $x$ and every sign $b$, the discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ at the point obtained by setting coordinate $i$ of $x$ to $b$ equals its value at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$x$ is a point of the sign cube
